summary: Investcorp AI Acquisition Corp. (IVCA) filed an 8-K/A reporting entry into a business combination agreement with Blue Finance Technology Holding Limited. The two-step deal involves Blue Finance shareholders contributing all shares to New Pubco (an Irish public limited company) in exchange for New Pubco ordinary shares, followed by a merger of Merger Sub with IVCA. Upfront equity consideration will be issued by New Pubco. No exact terms, premium, or advisors are stated. This is a SPAC de-SPAC merger. Watch for shareholder approvals, redemptions, and regulatory filings.
